data.title: bn-2v6: Replace procedural insects and Buzzkill with authored sprites

data.body: [P2] Draw the Golden Fly gnat inside the authored identity-palette scope. This `aspr("gnat.fly", ...)` is the only authored enemy draw that bypasses `begin_authored_sprite_scope`/`restore_legacy_palette`; at this point `reset_draw_state` has installed `INK_MAP`, so the gnat source set `{6,8,12,48}` is actually written as `{14,4,59,48}`. Wrap only the sprite call so the following legacy `BONUS` primitive remains mapped, and add a palette/restoration probe for this call site.

[P1] Keep phase-3 art on the documented live sockets instead of moving the visible pod away from its fixed collider. The phase-3 branches currently omit the upper-left wing (`phase<3`), place the lower-right wing at `(36,-28)` rather than `(34,-30)`, shift both cores/armors/shutter/claw down by `phase_slump=6` (and upper pod right by 2), and replace the full cannon with a short primitive stump. ART-BIBLE.md:326 requires both upper wings, both cores/armors, claw and cannon at their accepted sockets, omitting only lower-left; `enemy_bounds` remains `[-25,-50,25,2)`, so the slump creates invisible contact above the art and visible body below it. Match that composition exactly and add a phase-3 socket/envelope regression rather than relying only on screenshots.

[P1] Rework and gate these pixels against the existing cluster and opaque-envelope contracts. The art bible permits at most two same-role isolated accents per actor frame, but independent 8-neighbor counts are 5 for every wasp frame, 6-9 for beetles, and 5-26 per boss module (101 in the assembled phase-1 rig). The phase-1 authored union is also `[-46,-50,46,5)`, not the required `[-46,-52,46,6)`, and its pod/armor union is `[-24,-50,24,2)`, not `[-25,-50,25,2)`. Thus the sprite does not visibly cover the top/bottom weapon edges or both contact-pod side edges. Clean the isolated quantization noise, extend opaque clusters to the exact sockets, and invoke `isolated_same_role_pixels` plus composed-bbox assertions in `enemy_atlas_matches_source_and_obeys_semantic_pixel_contracts`; that test currently checks only dimensions/palette/source equality and therefore accepts these violations.

data.reason: Authored enemy palette scoping is incomplete, phase-3 Buzzkill diverges from fixed live sockets/collision, and the atlas violates the committed cluster and opaque-envelope contracts without regression coverage.

data.body: [P2] Reconcile the phase-3 weak-point socket instead of leaving three different authoritative coordinates. The revised table still says `(0,-23)` matches the weapon-envelope center and the vulnerable row says the aim socket stays there, but `draw_buzzkill` places the phase-3 shutter at `-23 + phase_slump = -17`, while the new `[-52,12)` damage envelope is centered at `-20` and laser fallback targeting derives that center from `enemy_bounds`. Define the P1-2 and P3 shutter/aim coordinates separately and align runtime/docs (or preserve the fixed socket intentionally), then assert the selected P3 socket alongside the new bounds test.
